/* rta-queries-batch-meta.mergeRtaSummonerOwnedBoxSnapFromStagingReplayChunk 소환사×몬스터 스냅과 동일: participant 존재하는 픽 행만(고아 픽 제외). */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_owned_box_snap (wizard_id, unit_master_id, computed_at) SELECT DISTINCT up.wizard_id::text, up.unit_master_id::bigint, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.staging_rta_summoner_snap_rid s ON s.replay_id = up.replay_id AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id AND mp.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE up.unit_master_id IS NOT NULL AND up.wizard_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT rta_agg_summoner_owned_box_snap_pkey DO UPDATE SET computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap (season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id, team_side, pick_slot_no, pick_cnt, win_cnt, field_cnt) WITH target_matches AS ( SELECT mp.replay_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.season_id, mp.rating_id, mp.is_winner::boolean AS is_winner, mp.is_first_pick::boolean AS is_first_pick FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}::bigint[]) ), picks AS ( SELECT up.unit_master_id, m.season_id, m.rating_id, CASE WHEN m.is_first_pick THEN 1 ELSE 2 END::smallint AS team_side, up.pick_slot_no::smallint AS pick_slot_no, m.is_winner FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN target_matches m ON m.replay_id = up.replay_id AND up.wizard_id = m.wizard_id WHERE up.unit_master_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT up.is_banned AND up.pick_slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ), field_per_rating AS ( SELECT m.season_id, m.rating_id::smallint AS rating_id, CASE WHEN m.is_first_pick THEN 1 ELSE 2 END::smallint AS team_side, COUNT(DISTINCT m.replay_id)::integer AS field_cnt FROM target_matches m GROUP BY m.season_id, m.rating_id, 3 ), field_all_rating AS ( SELECT m.season_id, (-1)::smallint AS rating_id, CASE WHEN m.is_first_pick THEN 1 ELSE 2 END::smallint AS team_side, COUNT(DISTINCT m.replay_id)::integer AS field_cnt FROM target_matches m GROUP BY m.season_id, 3 ), per_rating AS ( SELECT p.season_id, p.rating_id::smallint, p.unit_master_id, p.team_side, p.pick_slot_no, COUNT(*)::integer AS pick_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_winner)::integer AS win_cnt FROM picks p GROUP BY p.season_id, p.rating_id, p.unit_master_id, p.team_side, p.pick_slot_no ), all_rating AS ( SELECT p.season_id, (-1)::smallint AS rating_id, p.unit_master_id, p.team_side, p.pick_slot_no, COUNT(*)::integer AS pick_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_winner)::integer AS win_cnt FROM picks p GROUP BY p.season_id, p.unit_master_id, p.team_side, p.pick_slot_no ) SELECT pr.season_id, pr.rating_id, pr.unit_master_id, pr.team_side, pr.pick_slot_no, pr.pick_cnt, pr.win_cnt, COALESCE(f.field_cnt, 0) AS field_cnt FROM per_rating pr LEFT JOIN field_per_rating f ON f.season_id = pr.season_id AND f.rating_id = pr.rating_id AND f.team_side = pr.team_side UNION ALL SELECT ar.season_id, ar.rating_id, ar.unit_master_id, ar.team_side, ar.pick_slot_no, ar.pick_cnt, ar.win_cnt, COALESCE(f.field_cnt, 0) AS field_cnt FROM all_rating ar LEFT JOIN field_all_rating f ON f.season_id = ar.season_id AND f.team_side = ar.team_side ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id, team_side, pick_slot_no) DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap.pick_cnt + EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, win_cnt = rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, field_cnt = rta_agg_monster_pick_slot_snap.field_cnt + EXCLUDED.field_cnt

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.rta_match WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND played_at >= #{snapHour}::timestamptz AND played_at < #{snapHour}::timestamptz + INTERVAL '1 hour'

SELECT generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('hour', (SELECT start_at FROM public.rta_season WHERE season_id = #{seasonId})), DATE_TRUNC('hour', COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(played_at) FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE season_id = #{seasonId}), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )), INTERVAL '1 hour' ) AS h EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT snapped_at FROM public.rta_agg_rank_cut_hourly_snap WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY h DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH tier_max AS ( SELECT rating_id, MAX(ladder_score) AS max_score FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND ladder_score > 0 AND played_at >= #{snapHour}::timestamptz AND played_at < #{snapHour}::timestamptz + INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY rating_id ), tier_grades AS ( SELECT rating_id, grade_slot, tier_sort, LAG(rating_id) OVER (ORDER BY tier_sort) AS lower_rating_id FROM public.rta_rating_grade WHERE grade_slot IS NOT NULL ) SELECT tg.grade_slot AS gradeSlot, COALESCE(tg.tier_sort, 0)::smallint AS sortOrder, GREATEST( COALESCE(rgs.min_win_points, 0)::bigint, COALESCE(tms.max_score + 1, 0)::bigint ) AS cutoffScore FROM public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs INNER JOIN tier_grades tg ON tg.rating_id = rgs.rating_id LEFT JOIN tier_max tms ON tms.rating_id = tg.lower_rating_id WHERE rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} AND rgs.min_win_points IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_rank_cut_hourly_snap (season_id, snapped_at, grade_slot, sort_order, cutoff_score) VALUES
(#{seasonId}, #{snapHour}::timestamptz, #{r.gradeSlot}, #{r.sortOrder}, #{r.cutoffScore})
ON CONFLICT (season_id, snapped_at, grade_slot) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.rta_agg_rank_cut_hourly_snap WHERE snapped_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '92 days'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.sort_order, h.grade_slot) a.sort_order AS "anchorSort", a.anchor_key AS "anchorKey", h.grade_slot AS "gradeSlot", h.sort_order AS "tierSort", h.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore", h.snapped_at AS "snappedAt", rg.rating_id AS "ratingId" FROM (VALUES (0, 'now', INTERVAL '0', INTERVAL '26 hours'), (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours', INTERVAL '26 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours', INTERVAL '26 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours', INTERVAL '36 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days', INTERVAL '5 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days', INTERVAL '10 days') ) AS a(sort_order, anchor_key, iv, max_age) JOIN public.rta_agg_rank_cut_hourly_snap h ON h.season_id = #{seasonId} AND h.snapped_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND h.snapped_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv - a.max_age LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.grade_slot = h.grade_slot ORDER BY a.sort_order, h.grade_slot, h.snapped_at DESC
SELECT s.score FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.rank_position = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON ((h.snapped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, h.grade_slot) (h.snapped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS "snappedDay", h.grade_slot AS "gradeSlot", h.sort_order AS "tierSort", h.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore" FROM public.rta_agg_rank_cut_hourly_snap h WHERE h.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY (h.snapped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, h.grade_slot, h.snapped_at DESC

SELECT c.opponent_monster_id::text AS "opponentComboKey", 1::smallint AS "opponentComboSize", c.win_cnt::bigint AS "winCnt", c.lose_cnt::bigint AS "loseCnt", c.match_cnt::bigint AS "matchCnt" FROM public.rta_agg_counter_solo c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY c.match_cnt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT c.opponent_monster_id AS "opponentComboKey", 2::smallint AS "opponentComboSize", c.win_cnt::bigint AS "winCnt", c.lose_cnt::bigint AS "loseCnt", c.match_cnt::bigint AS "matchCnt" FROM public.rta_agg_counter_duo c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY c.match_cnt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

SELECT c.opponent_monster_id AS "opponentComboKey", 3::smallint AS "opponentComboSize", c.win_cnt::bigint AS "winCnt", c.lose_cnt::bigint AS "loseCnt", c.match_cnt::bigint AS "matchCnt" FROM public.rta_agg_counter_trio c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.rating_id = #{ratingId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY c.match_cnt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

mapper.insert: /* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaPickTurnAggForSeason */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_pick_turn ( season_id, rating_id, monster_id, pick_slot_no, team_side, pick_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, ban_cnt, updated_at ) SELECT z.season_id, z.rating_id, z.monster_id, z.pick_slot_no, z.team_side, COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT z.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT z.is_banned AND z.is_winner IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT z.is_banned AND z.is_winner IS FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN z.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ban_cnt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT mp.season_id, mp.rating_id, up.unit_master_id::bigint AS monster_id, up.pick_slot_no::smallint AS pick_slot_no, /* team_side: is_first_pick 기준 — pick_slot_no 는 플레이어별 1~5 */ CASE WHEN mp.is_first_pick IS TRUE THEN 1::smallint ELSE 2::smallint END AS team_side, up.is_banned, mp.is_winner FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.rating_id > 0 AND up.pick_slot_no BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ) z GROUP BY z.season_id, z.rating_id, z.monster_id, z.pick_slot_no, z.team_side

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaSummonerOpponentH2hSnapForSeason 동일 replay_id×위자드 participant 중복 행이 있어도 경기당 1회만 집계한다. */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_opponent_h2h_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, opponent_wizard_id, opponent_wizard_name, opponent_channel_uid, opponent_country_code, match_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT d.season_id, d.wizard_id, d.opponent_wizard_id, MAX(d.opponent_wizard_name), MAX(d.opponent_channel_uid), MAX(d.opponent_country_code), COUNT(*)::bigint, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_winner IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_winner IS FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.replay_id, me.wizard_id, o.wizard_id) me.season_id, me.wizard_id, o.wizard_id AS opponent_wizard_id, o.wizard_name AS opponent_wizard_name, o.channel_uid AS opponent_channel_uid, o.country_code AS opponent_country_code, me.is_winner FROM public.rta_match_participant me INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant o ON o.replay_id = me.replay_id AND o.wizard_id <> me.wizard_id WHERE me.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY me.replay_id, me.wizard_id, o.wizard_id ) d GROUP BY d.season_id, d.wizard_id, d.opponent_wizard_id

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.selectSeasonIdsWithPendingSummonerRankingReplays */ SELECT DISTINCT m.season_id FROM public.rta_match m WHERE m.summoner_ranking_apply_result IS NULL ORDER BY m.season_id
mapper.insert: /* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaSummonerSeasonFightSnapForSeason — 시즌 전원 분모 집계 UPSERT (rta_match 소환사 스냅 플래그와 무관) */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, match_cnt, win_cnt, non_ban_pick_cnt, ban_event_cnt, computed_at ) WITH part AS ( SELECT mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.replay_id)::bigint AS match_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mp.is_winner IS TRUE THEN mp.replay_id END)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id ), picks AS ( SELECT mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS non_ban_pick_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ban_event_cnt FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id ) SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, p.match_cnt, p.win_cnt, COALESCE(pk.non_ban_pick_cnt, 0::bigint), COALESCE(pk.ban_event_cnt, 0::bigint), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM part p LEFT JOIN picks pk ON pk.season_id = p.season_id AND pk.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap_pkey DO UPDATE SET match_cnt = EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = EXCLUDED.win_cnt, non_ban_pick_cnt = EXCLUDED.non_ban_pick_cnt, ban_event_cnt = EXCLUDED.ban_event_cnt, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaSummonerMonsterSnapForSeasonReplayChunk */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, first_pick_cnt, owned_copy_count, computed_at ) WITH pnorm AS ( SELECT mp.replay_id, mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.is_winner, mp.is_first_pick FROM public.rta_match_participant mp INNER JOIN public.staging_rta_summoner_snap_rid s ON s.season_id = mp.season_id AND s.replay_id = mp.replay_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} ), upnorm AS ( /* (replay_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id) 중복 시 논밴 픽 행 우선 — 밴 행만 남으면 승패 집계가 0으로 깨짐 */ SELECT DISTINCT ON (up.replay_id, up.wizard_id, up.unit_master_id) up.replay_id, up.wizard_id, up.unit_master_id, up.is_banned, up.pick_slot_no FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.staging_rta_summoner_snap_rid s ON s.replay_id = up.replay_id AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY up.replay_id, up.wizard_id, up.unit_master_id, up.is_banned ASC, up.pick_slot_no ASC ), agg AS ( SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, u.unit_master_id, /* pick_cnt: 드래프트에서 이 몬을 택한 횟수(밴으로 끝난 판 포함). 리스트 노출·픽률 분모와 일치 */ COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.is_banned)::bigint AS ban_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND p.is_winner IS TRUE)::bigint AS win_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND p.is_winner IS NOT TRUE)::bigint AS lose_cnt, /* 1번픽 수: 해당 플레이어 팀의 pick 순서 로컬 1번(rta_match_unit_pick.pick_slot_no = 1) */ COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND u.pick_slot_no::int = 1 )::bigint AS first_pick_cnt FROM pnorm p INNER JOIN upnorm u ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id GROUP BY p.season_id, p.wizard_id, u.unit_master_id ) SELECT d.season_id, d.wizard_id, d.unit_master_id, d.pick_cnt, d.ban_cnt, d.win_cnt, d.lose_cnt, d.first_pick_cnt, d.owned_copy_count, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT a.season_id, a.wizard_id, a.unit_master_id, MAX(a.pick_cnt)::bigint AS pick_cnt, MAX(a.ban_cnt)::bigint AS ban_cnt, MAX(a.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, MAX(a.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt, MAX(a.first_pick_cnt)::bigint AS first_pick_cnt, MAX(COALESCE(o.copy_count, 0))::int AS owned_copy_count FROM agg a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wizard_id, master_id, MAX(copy_count)::int AS copy_count FROM public.user_monster_owned_agg GROUP BY wizard_id, master_id ) o ON o.wizard_id = a.wizard_id AND o.master_id = a.unit_master_id GROUP BY a.season_id, a.wizard_id, a.unit_master_id ) d ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap_pkey DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.pick_cnt + EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, ban_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.ban_cnt + EXCLUDED.ban_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, first_pick_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.first_pick_cnt + EXCLUDED.first_pick_cnt, owned_copy_count = GREATEST( public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap.owned_copy_count, EXCLUDED.owned_copy_count ), computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaSummonerPickTurnSnapForSeasonReplayChunk */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_slot_no, team_side, pick_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, ban_cnt, computed_at ) WITH pnorm AS ( SELECT mp.replay_id, mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.is_winner, mp.is_first_pick FROM public.rta_match_participant mp INNER JOIN public.staging_rta_summoner_snap_rid s ON s.season_id = mp.season_id AND s.replay_id = mp.replay_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} ), upnorm AS ( /* (replay_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_slot_no) 중복 방지 */ SELECT DISTINCT up.replay_id, up.wizard_id, up.unit_master_id, up.is_banned, up.pick_slot_no FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.staging_rta_summoner_snap_rid s ON s.replay_id = up.replay_id AND s.season_id = #{seasonId} ), picked AS ( SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, u.unit_master_id::bigint AS unit_master_id, /* 원천 pick_slot_no = 플레이어 팀 기준 1~5(별도 매핑 없음) */ u.pick_slot_no::smallint AS pick_slot_no, CASE WHEN p.is_first_pick IS TRUE THEN 1::smallint ELSE 2::smallint END AS team_side, u.is_banned, p.is_winner FROM pnorm p INNER JOIN upnorm u ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE u.pick_slot_no::int BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ), agg AS ( SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, p.unit_master_id, p.pick_slot_no, p.team_side, COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p.is_banned AND p.is_winner IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p.is_banned AND p.is_winner IS NOT TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ban_cnt FROM picked p GROUP BY p.season_id, p.wizard_id, p.unit_master_id, p.pick_slot_no, p.team_side ) SELECT a.season_id, a.wizard_id, a.unit_master_id, a.pick_slot_no, a.team_side, a.pick_cnt, a.match_cnt, a.win_cnt, a.lose_cnt, a.ban_cnt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM agg a ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap_pkey DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap.pick_cnt + EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, match_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap.match_cnt + EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap.win_cnt + EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap.lose_cnt + EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, ban_cnt = public.rta_agg_summoner_pick_turn_snap.ban_cnt + EXCLUDED.ban_cnt, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'S', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, t.pick_cnt, t.ban_cnt, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.pick_cnt, g.ban_cnt, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g.pick_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.pick_cnt)::bigint AS pick_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(sg.ban_cnt, 0))::bigint AS ban_cnt, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_solo sg INNER JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = sg.combo_unit_key WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.pick_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'D', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, NULL, NULL, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY g.match_cnt DESC, (g.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(g.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_duo sg INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.match_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'T', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, NULL, NULL, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY g.match_cnt DESC, (g.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(g.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_trio sg INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) INNER JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.match_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaSummonerOwnedBoxSnapFromRtaUnitPicks */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_owned_box_snap (wizard_id, unit_master_id, computed_at) SELECT DISTINCT up.wizard_id::text, up.unit_master_id::bigint, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE up.unit_master_id IS NOT NULL AND up.wizard_id IS NOT NULL

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.selectParticipantSeasonsWithStart */ SELECT DISTINCT mp.season_id, rs.start_at::date AS start_date FROM public.rta_match_participant mp INNER JOIN public.rta_season rs ON rs.season_id = mp.season_id WHERE mp.season_id IS NOT NULL AND rs.start_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mp.season_id

/* rta-queries-batch-meta.selectMissingMonsterDailySnapDates */ SELECT gs::date::text AS snap_date FROM generate_series( #{fromDate}::date, CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1 day' ) AS gs WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND s.snap_date = gs::date ) ORDER BY gs
mapper.insert: /* rta-queries-batch-meta.insertRtaMonsterDailySnapForDate */ INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_daily_snap (snap_date, season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id, pick_cnt, win_cnt, ban_cnt, lead_cnt, field_cnt) WITH matches AS ( /* participant 중복 적재가 있어도 (replay_id, wizard_id) 1행만 집계 */ SELECT DISTINCT ON (mp.replay_id, mp.wizard_id) mp.replay_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.rating_id, mp.is_winner, mp.is_first_pick, mp.leader_pick_slot FROM public.rta_match_participant mp INNER JOIN public.rta_match rm ON rm.replay_id = mp.replay_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND rm.played_at::date = #{snapDate}::date ORDER BY mp.replay_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.played_at DESC NULLS LAST ), picks AS ( SELECT up.unit_master_id, m.rating_id, up.is_banned::boolean AS is_banned, m.is_winner::boolean AS is_winner, (up.pick_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND m.leader_pick_slot = up.pick_slot_no AND NOT up.is_banned)::boolean AS is_leader FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN matches m ON m.replay_id = up.replay_id AND up.wizard_id = m.wizard_id WHERE up.unit_master_id IS NOT NULL ), field AS ( SELECT rating_id, COUNT(DISTINCT replay_id)::integer AS field_cnt FROM matches GROUP BY rating_id ), per_tier AS ( SELECT p.unit_master_id, p.rating_id::smallint AS rating_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.is_banned)::integer AS pick_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_winner AND NOT p.is_banned)::integer AS win_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_banned)::integer AS ban_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.is_leader)::integer AS lead_cnt FROM picks p GROUP BY p.unit_master_id, p.rating_id ) SELECT #{snapDate}::date AS snap_date, #{seasonId}::bigint AS season_id, pt.rating_id, pt.unit_master_id, pt.pick_cnt, pt.win_cnt, pt.ban_cnt, pt.lead_cnt, COALESCE(f.field_cnt, 0) AS field_cnt FROM per_tier pt LEFT JOIN field f ON f.rating_id = pt.rating_id ON CONFLICT (snap_date, season_id, rating_id, unit_master_id) DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, win_cnt = EXCLUDED.win_cnt, ban_cnt = EXCLUDED.ban_cnt, lead_cnt = EXCLUDED.lead_cnt, field_cnt = EXCLUDED.field_cnt
